tests.name: Dequantized close to original
tests.code:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)
w = torch.randn(16, 8)
q = {fn}(w)
w_recon = q.weight_int8.float() * q.scale
assert (w - w_recon).abs().max() < 0.1, 'Quantization error too large'

tests.name: Forward output shape
tests.code:
import torch
q = {fn}(torch.randn(8, 4), torch.randn(8))
out = q(torch.randn(2, 4))
assert out.shape == (2, 8), f'Shape: {out.shape}'

tests.name: Weight is buffer not parameter
tests.code:
import torch
q = {fn}(torch.randn(4, 4))
param_names = [n for n, _ in q.named_parameters()]
assert 'weight_int8' not in param_names, 'weight_int8 should be a buffer'
assert 'scale' not in param_names, 'scale should be a buffer'
